title: Resume SDDC Manager domain collection after token refresh
prompt:
Complete `VcfDomainClient.java` as a single-file Java 17, standard-library-only client for VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 SDDC Manager.

Before implementing, research the `createToken`, `getDomain`, and `refreshAccessToken` operations in the SDDC Manager OpenAPI specification in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository and cite the specification URLs consulted. Do not contact any other SDDC Manager route.

Preserve the public constructor, record, and `collectDomains` signature already declared in the client and implement these rules:

- Use only Java 17 standard-library APIs. The constructor performs no traffic. Every request uses the supplied base URI and sends `Accept: application/json`.
- Start `createToken` as exactly `POST /v1/tokens`, with no query or `Authorization` header. Send `Content-Type: application/json`. The body contains `username` and `password`. `apiKey` and `idToken` are optional: null means unset and each unset property must be omitted rather than serialized as an empty string or JSON null. Escape every JSON string correctly. Accept exactly the live HTTP 200 and require a string `accessToken` plus a nested string `refreshToken.id` in the returned `TokenPair`.
- Retrieve the requested domains in input order with exactly `GET /v1/domains/{id}`. Encode each ID as one UTF-8 URI path segment. A domain GET has no query, body, `Content-Type`, or empty query delimiter, and sends `Authorization: Bearer <current-access-token>`. Accept HTTP 200 and parse the `id`, `name`, `status`, and `type` strings into the supplied `Domain` record. Treat a malformed selected field or any unexpected non-401 status as `IOException`.
- If the initial access token expires after some domains have already been returned, call `refreshAccessToken` once on the first 401 as exactly `PATCH /v1/tokens/access-token/refresh`, with no query or `Authorization` header. Send `Content-Type: application/json` and encode the refresh-token ID as the entire JSON string request body, not as an object or a bare unquoted value. Accept exactly HTTP 200 whose entire response document is the refreshed access-token JSON string.
- Retry only the interrupted domain GET with the refreshed bearer token, then continue with the remaining IDs. Do not restart the batch, refetch a completed domain, skip the interrupted domain, reorder results, or add a failed attempt to the returned list. A second 401 after the single refresh is an `IOException`.
- Reject a null username or password, a null domain ID list, null list elements, and an empty domain ID list before any traffic. Return an unmodifiable result list. Do not include credentials, access tokens, or the refresh-token ID in exception messages.

Do not modify `tests/`; edit only `VcfDomainClient.java`. Run `python3 tests/verify.py`.
scenario: the initial access token expires on the second domain after the first result is complete; refresh once, retry only the interrupted domain, and preserve the batch
